title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.13801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology

translated_title: 融合图学习与成对学习用于从单细胞RNA测序数据推断基因调控网络
translated_abstract: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有的GRN推断方法通常分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；以及基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法所存在的局限性恰恰是其对应方法的优势所在。基于图的方法由于依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而基于成对的方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，基于成对的方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而全局拓扑结构对于全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了scGPL，一个端到端的统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑
tldr: 提出scGPL端到端统一框架，融合图学习与成对学习两类方法的优势，联合建模全局调控拓扑与TF-靶基因对，解决了图方法易过拟合、成对方法忽视全局拓扑结构的局限，实现更准确的基因调控网络推断。
en_tdlr: scGPL is an end-to-end unified framework that bridges graph-based and pairwise-based learning to jointly model global regulatory topology and TF-target gene pairs, overcoming the overfitting and topology-blindness limitations of existing methods for gene regulatory network inference from scRNA-seq data.
